name: routing_single_one_attempt
state: A host whose one app, routing_caller, requires the test contract routing_single_one_attempt.v1, whose actions are get (idempotent) and put (not idempotent), each taking and returning a record with one integer field n, and holds a shared-secret key to sign its calls. The host's settings list U as the remote providers of routing_single_one_attempt.v1, in that order, and leave it out of the routing policies, so it is routed by single. Each provider listens on a loopback address and records every request it receives: U answers 503 with no neolith error body.
procedure: 1. From a root of routing_caller that holds a principal, a tracestate and a timeout of 10 seconds, call get with {"n":1}.
expected: The call fails with unavailable. U receives exactly one request, and no request is sent again.

name: routing_moves_on_503
state: A host whose one app, routing_caller, requires the test contract routing_moves_on_503.v1, whose actions are get (idempotent) and put (not idempotent), each taking and returning a record with one integer field n, and holds a shared-secret key to sign its calls. The host's settings list U, then B as the remote providers of routing_moves_on_503.v1, in that order, and name local-first for it. Each provider listens on a loopback address and records every request it receives: U answers 503 with no neolith error body; B answers 200 with the reply {"n":7}.
procedure:
1. From a root of routing_caller that holds a principal, a tracestate and a timeout of 10 seconds, call get with {"n":1}.
2. The host's clock stands still at a whole number of seconds from before the root opens; U moves it by 5 ms after it reads its request and before it answers.
expected: The call returns B's reply, {"n":7}. U receives one request, then B one. The two carry the same Idempotency-Key, Neolith-Principal, trace identifier in traceparent and tracestate, a different span identifier in traceparent, and an Authorization token minted for each attempt. B's Neolith-Timeout is 5 less than U's.
